status: Three operational findings fixed and verified; no remaining blocking code issue found in scope

findings.problem: A fresh rollout stopped once either Arbitrum Safe already existed, preventing review after executing the prescribed bootstrap.
findings.resolution: Validate canonical existing Safes and approved intermediate owner states; emit only remaining creations/owner additions; completed setup is a no-op.
validation: Independent local fork: missing, partly created, original, partly rotated and completed Safes; stale and unexpected owner states rejected; FT nonce unchanged.

findings.problem: A fresh run after FT deployment expected the final owner immediately and omitted the still-required ownership/activation batches.
findings.resolution: Accept the constructor delegate on expansion chains; derive ownership transfer and optional activation from actual owner/pause state, independently of whether FT code already exists.
validation: Nested local Monad fork: already deployed FT, no second deployment, remaining ownership and activation executed, supply preserved, complete messaging quotes passed.

findings.problem: The pinned deployment path tolerates missing local compiler artifacts, but the mandatory postcheck still required an FT artifact after broadcast.
findings.resolution: Construct the read-only contract from the saved deployment ABI and provider.
validation: Works with saved ABI while artifact and signer access are forbidden
Rejects an incorrect initial non-mint supply
